script.name: Mayhem.ShipName.SetReadout
script.description: Set a ship name with its cargo readout

line.comment: * One active readout per ship. Virus readouts take priority over cargo.
* Detach a terminal colour reset, if present.
* Only the owning subsystem may clear a readout.
* Cargo cannot overwrite an active infection warning.
* If the old suffix is embedded in the name, do not
* blindly append another status or delete arbitrary text.
* Avoid appending a readout already present at the end.
* Update the single active ownership record.

sval.val: Set a ship name with its cargo readout
One active readout per ship. Virus readouts take priority over cargo.
